# m.stocks.financials.balance_sheets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Balance sheets of US public companies, one row per filer and reporting period.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.financials.balance_sheets(symbols=None, *, timeframe=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Cik`, `PeriodEnd`, `Timeframe` and `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Tickers whose filings to return; leave it out for every filing. `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| `timeframe` | `dm.Timeframe.ANNUAL` or `QUARTERLY`; leave it out for both. A balance sheet has no trailing twelve months. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first period end date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last period end date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"fiscal_year"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"fiscal_year_gte": 2020}`. Keys: `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `cik_gt`, `cik_gte`, `cik_lt`, `cik_lte`, `filing_date`, `filing_date_gt`, `filing_date_gte`, `filing_date_lt`, `filing_date_lte`, `fiscal_quarter`, `fiscal_quarter_gt`, `fiscal_quarter_gte`, `fiscal_quarter_lt`, `fiscal_quarter_lte`, `fiscal_year`, `fiscal_year_gt`, `fiscal_year_gte`, `fiscal_year_lt`, `fiscal_year_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Balance Sheets (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Not included |
| Stocks Starter | Not included |
| Stocks Developer | Not included |
| Stocks Advanced | End-of-day, All history |
| Financials & Ratios Expansion | End-of-day, All history |
| Stocks Business | Not included |
| Financials & Ratios Expansion Business | End-of-day, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The ticker the request named that the row lists in `Tickers`: a row that lists several of the named tickers appears once for each, so an article about AAPL and MSFT read for both is listed under each. A request that named one ticker gives it to every row. Null when the call named no ticker, and on a row that lists none of a request's named tickers. |
| `AccountsPayable` | double | Amounts owed to suppliers and vendors for goods and services purchased on credit. |
| `AccruedAndOtherCurrentLiabilities` | double | Current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including accrued expenses, taxes payable, and other obligations due within one year. |
| `AccumulatedOtherComprehensiveIncome` | double | Cumulative gains and losses that bypass the income statement, including foreign currency translation adjustments and unrealized gains/losses on securities. |
| `AdditionalPaidInCapital` | double | Amount received from shareholders in excess of the par or stated value of shares issued. |
| `CashAndEquivalents` | double | Cash on hand and short-term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash. |
| `Cik` | String | The company's Central Index Key (CIK), a unique identifier assigned by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). You can look up a company's CIK using the SEC CIK Lookup tool (https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/cik-lookup). |
| `CommitmentsAndContingencies` | double | Disclosed amount related to contractual commitments and potential liabilities that may arise from uncertain future events. |
| `CommonStock` | double | Par or stated value of common shares outstanding representing basic ownership in the company. |
| `DebtCurrent` | double | Short-term borrowings and the current portion of long-term debt due within one year. |
| `DeferredRevenueCurrent` | double | Customer payments received in advance for goods or services to be delivered within one year. |
| `FilingDate` | String | The date of the most recent SEC filing that included this period's data. This is not necessarily the date this period was originally filed. Because SEC filings restate comparative data for prior periods, multiple records can share the same filing_date. For example, an annual 10-K reports three years of results, and a 10-Q includes prior period comparatives. To find the original filing date for a specific 10-K or 10-Q, use the SEC EDGAR filings index endpoint (/stocks/filings/vX/index). |
| `FiscalQuarter` | long | The fiscal quarter number (1, 2, 3, or 4) for the reporting period. |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year for the reporting period. |
| `Goodwill` | double | Intangible asset representing the excess of purchase price over fair value of net assets acquired in business combinations. |
| `IntangibleAssetsNet` | double | Intangible assets other than goodwill, including patents, trademarks, and customer relationships, net of accumulated amortization. |
| `Inventories` | double | Raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods held for sale in the ordinary course of business. |
| `LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations` | double | Long-term borrowings and capital lease obligations with maturities greater than one year. |
| `NoncontrollingInterest` | double | Equity in consolidated subsidiaries not owned by the parent company, representing minority shareholders' ownership. |
| `OtherAssets` | double | Non-current assets not classified elsewhere, including long-term investments, deferred tax assets, and other long-term assets. |
| `OtherCurrentAssets` | double | Current assets not classified elsewhere, including prepaid expenses, taxes receivable, and other assets expected to be converted to cash within one year. |
| `OtherEquity` | double | Equity components not classified elsewhere in shareholders' equity. |
| `OtherNoncurrentLiabilities` | double | Non-current liabilities not classified elsewhere, including deferred tax liabilities, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities. |
| `PeriodEnd` | String | The last date of the reporting period, representing the specific point in time when the balance sheet snapshot was taken. |
| `PreferredStock` | double | Par or stated value of preferred shares outstanding with preferential rights over common stock. |
| `PropertyPlantEquipmentNet` | double | Tangible fixed assets used in operations, reported net of accumulated depreciation. |
| `Receivables` | double | Amounts owed to the company by customers and other parties, primarily accounts receivable, net of allowances for doubtful accounts. |
| `RetainedEarningsDeficit` | double | Cumulative net income earned by the company less dividends paid to shareholders since inception. |
| `ShortTermInvestments` | double | Marketable securities and other investments with maturities of one year or less that are not classified as cash equivalents. |
| `Tickers` | String[] | A list of ticker symbols under which the company is listed. Multiple symbols may indicate different share classes for the same company. |
| `Timeframe` | String | The reporting period type. Possible values include: quarterly, annual. |
| `TotalAssets` | double | Sum of all current and non-current assets representing everything the company owns or controls. |
| `TotalCurrentAssets` | double | Sum of all current assets expected to be converted to cash, sold, or consumed within one year. |
| `TotalCurrentLiabilities` | double | Sum of all liabilities expected to be settled within one year. |
| `TotalEquity` | double | Sum of all equity components representing shareholders' total ownership interest in the company. |
| `TotalEquityAttributableToParent` | double | Total shareholders' equity attributable to the parent company, excluding noncontrolling interests. |
| `TotalLiabilities` | double | Sum of all current and non-current liabilities representing everything the company owes. |
| `TotalLiabilitiesAndEquity` | double | Sum of total liabilities and total equity, which should equal total assets per the fundamental accounting equation. |
| `TreasuryStock` | double | Cost of the company's own shares that have been repurchased and are held in treasury, typically reported as a negative value. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
